Specification: VoteProof: PlusCal specification with TLA+ translation for voting-based consensus (Paxos ballot voting layer). Models acceptors using votes (function from Acceptor to sets of <ballot, value> pairs) and maxBal. Defines SafeAt via a recursive LET function SA, invariants VInv1-4 and VInv, actions IncreaseMaxBal/VoteFor/BallotAction, LiveAssumption, and LiveSpec. Instantiates Consensus (C == INSTANCE Consensus). Proves invariance (VT2: Spec => []VInv), refinement (VT3: Spec => C!Spec), unique choice (VT1), quorum ballot theorem (VT4), and liveness (LiveSpec => C!LiveSpec).
ProofHints: BY DEF Next, BallotAction, IncreaseMaxBal, VoteFor, ProcSet, acceptor
AssumeProveBlocks:
ASSUME QA == /\ \A Q \in Quorum : Q \subseteq Acceptor
             /\ \A Q1, Q2 \in Quorum : Q1 \cap Q2 # {}  
 
THEOREM QuorumNonEmpty == \A Q \in Quorum : Q # {}
PROOF BY QA

VARIABLES votes, maxBal


VotedFor(a, b, v) == <<b, v>> \in votes[a]

DidNotVoteIn(a, b) == \A v \in Value : ~ VotedFor(a, b, v)

SafeAt(b, v) ==
  LET SA[bb \in Ballot] ==
        \/ bb = 0
        \/ \E Q \in Quorum :
             /\ \A a \in Q : maxBal[a] \geq bb
             /\ \E c \in -1..(bb-1) :
                  /\ (c # -1) => /\ SA[c]
                                 /\ \A a \in Q :
                                      \A w \in Value :
                                         VotedFor(a, c, w) => (w = v)
                  /\ \A d \in (c+1)..(bb-1), a \in Q : DidNotVoteIn(a, d)
  IN  SA[b]

vars == << votes, maxBal >>

ProcSet == (Acceptor)

Init == 
        /\ votes = [a \in Acceptor |-> {}]
        /\ maxBal = [a \in Acceptor |-> -1]

acceptor(self) == \E b \in Ballot:
                    \/ /\ b > maxBal[self]
                       /\ maxBal' = [maxBal EXCEPT ![self] = b]
                       /\ UNCHANGED votes
                    \/ /\ \E v \in Value:
                            /\ /\ maxBal[self] \leq b
                               /\ DidNotVoteIn(self, b)
                               /\ \A p \in Acceptor \ {self} :
                                     \A w \in Value : VotedFor(p, b, w) => (w = v)
                               /\ SafeAt(b, v)
                            /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![self] = votes[self] \cup {<<b, v>>}]
                            /\ maxBal' = [maxBal EXCEPT ![self] = b]


Next == (\E self \in Acceptor: acceptor(self))

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

THEOREM SafeAtProp ==
  \A b \in Ballot, v \in Value :
    SafeAt(b, v) <=>
      \/ b = 0
      \/ \E Q \in Quorum :
           /\ \A a \in Q : maxBal[a] \geq b
           /\ \E c \in -1..(b-1) :
                /\ (c # -1) => /\ SafeAt(c, v)
                               /\ \A a \in Q :
                                    \A w \in Value :
                                        VotedFor(a, c, w) => (w = v)
                /\ \A d \in (c+1)..(b-1), a \in Q : DidNotVoteIn(a, d)
<1>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW v \in Value PROVE  \A b \in Ballot : SafeAtProp!(b, v)
